title: Truck or Ball? Momentum Explained Simply | PUC Physics Class 11
description:
A truck creeps past the college gate at walking pace. A cricket ball flies off a bat forty times faster. Which one is harder to stop? Speed alone cannot tell you, and mass alone cannot either. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Physics (NCERT Chapter 4, Laws of Motion) we meet momentum, p = mv, and the full form of Newton's second law, F = dp/dt.

On a live motion notebook a 0.5 kg ball and a 2 kg cart roll side by side while the readout and a momentum vs velocity graph move with them: at the same speed the cart has four times the momentum, and when the ball goes four times faster their momentum is the same. A slow-mo replay draws the velocity and momentum arrows, and stopping both in the same half second needs the same 8 N force. Then we derive F = dp/dt from F = ma step by step, see why momentum is a vector, compare the slow truck and the fast ball side by side, work through a van example, see the exam trap (convert km/h to m/s first), solve an original JEE Main pattern question and finish with a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, JEE Main and NEET students.

In this video:
